elements.notes: Full-width translucent dark band behind the nav (no border, no radius). Hard lower edge at y=33.6 (row 33 is the anti-aliased step: L 42->56 at x150, 48->88 at x200, 73->117 at x300; almost no step at x<100 where the left scrim is already dark and at x>500). Composite colour inside the band: x0 #051222, x90 #101D2C, x190 #19273B, x290 #273850, x350 #314158, x440 #3F485E, x505 #2E425C, i.e. roughly the scene darkened by #0A1628 at ~40%. It is nav UI, so it is marked remove=true (pad 0): the whole 0..33.6 strip is inpainted, otherwise a baked hard edge would misalign with the Unity nav bar at other aspect ratios. Unity: draw the nav bar 0..33.6 (anchor top, stretch width) with #0A1628 at ~40-45% alpha (optional 4px backdrop blur); that restores the concept look and hides any inpainting softness. No nav tab is highlighted on this page (no nav.tab_selected / underline).
